scientific_role.reason: Figure 4 is from an independent experimental campaign, but important condition mismatches remain.

extraction_scope.error_bar_policy: Do not interpret or convert plotted error bars until their statistical meaning is explicitly reconciled from the source.

metadata_rules.pressure: Pressure must come from explicit source-supported condition mapping. Do not infer pressure merely from the normoxic relation.
metadata_rules.flow: Microgravity Figure 4 points use 100 mm/s opposed flow. Normal-gravity points must not be assigned an equivalent forced-flow velocity.
metadata_rules.measurement: Digitized Figure 4 points represent reported propagation-rate results, not raw replicate measurements.
metadata_rules.independence: Independent publication and campaign do not by themselves make every point eligible for direct model validation.

digitization_uncertainty_policy.rule: Figure 2.21 digitization uncertainty must never be reused for Figure 4.

required_before_direct_validation: Acquire and freeze the source PDF.
Reconcile pressure for every extracted point.
Preserve the 50 versus 100 mm/s flow mismatch.
Do not mark any row validation-eligible until condition compatibility is reviewed.
